metadata.title: Hierarchical Ensemble Personalization (HEP-FL) Master Experimental Suite
metadata.description: Consolidated benchmark evaluation datasets across Personalization (FEMNIST & CIFAR-100), Byzantine Multi-Attack Robustness, 50-Client Scalability, and MobileNetV3 Edge Hardware Profiling.
metadata.hardware: 1x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM, Ada Lovelace), CUDA 12.4 / 12.8, Runpod EU-RO-1

femnist_personalization.description: Baseline 1: High-Class-Cardinality Personalization on FEMNIST (62 classes, 1-channel, ResNet-9)

cifar100_personalization.description: Baseline 1 / Table II: High-Class-Cardinality Personalization on CIFAR-100 (100 classes, 3-channel, ResNet-9)

cifar100_byzantine_robustness.description: Baseline 2 / Table III: CIFAR-100 Byzantine Multi-Attack Robustness Matrix across Attacker Fractions

scale_50clients.description: Baseline 2 / Table IV: 50-Client Population Scaling with Partial Participation (N=50, Cp=0.20, 20 Rounds)

mobilenet_edge_vision.description: Baseline 2 / Table V & V-B: MobileNetV3-Small Hardware Footprint & Personalization Accuracy
